signed_op_valid.meaning: a valid 77-byte signed UserOperation exists whose owner signature covers only the 65-byte rawSignature and userOpHash

relayer_holds_op.meaning: the relayer/bundler holds that valid 77-byte signed operation

suffix_excluded_from_hash.meaning: getUserOpHash excludes the signature field so the last 12 bytes (validUntil/validAfter) are not part of userOpHash

window_authenticated.meaning: the validUntil/validAfter time window is covered by the owner's signature so a relayer cannot alter it without invalidating the signature
window_authenticated.checkpoint: at signature verification of the submitted operation

unauthorized_wallet_actions.meaning: AtomWallet.execute performs unauthorized token transfers, approvals, or other wallet actions at attacker-chosen times
unauthorized_wallet_actions.checkpoint: at execution of the modified operation

assumptions: The relayer submits the modified UserOperation for validation and execution.
AtomWallet.execute can perform arbitrary calls on behalf of the wallet.
The 12-byte suffix carries validUntil/validAfter time-window data.

unresolved.description: Report does not give numeric validUntil/validAfter values or a concrete window, so the time-window bound is represented only by the grounded Boolean window_authenticated rather than a numeric comparison.

limitations: The claim formalizes only i_unauthorized_wallet_actions; i_window_not_enforced and i_execute_outside_window are not covered by this plan.
Whether the rewritten window is actually accepted by EntryPoint validation is described as a capability, not an observed incident.
The relayer's status as legitimate bundler versus external attacker is not resolved beyond holding the signed op.
